LANDING.TITLE: Site Information
LANDING.WHAT_IS_DESC: Planning Time is a web platform where you can generate a task estimation session in simple steps.
LANDING.HOW_WORKS_DESC: You must enter a team name, then a QR and a Link are made available, which you can share with those you want to participate in the estimation.
LANDING.HOW_STARTED_DESC: Planning Time arose from the need to obtain and establish a score for each sprint task in a simple and fast way.
LANDING.PROBLEMS_DESC: If you encountered any inconvenience, or have an idea to improve the platform
LANDING.CONTACT: You can write to me at:

SCALE_MODAL.TITLE: Change voting scale
SCALE_MODAL.SCALE_TOOLTIP: You can customize the scale, Ex: 1,2,3,🚀,🍕
